content: Verify object correspondence before fitting physics from RGB-D. Positive depth on the largest color component can belong to an unrelated object. Missing wrist depth cannot be filled using simulated ground truth.
applicability: Color-segmented RGB-D diagnostics; task/camera-specific ROI only for inspected grasp/lift views
limitations: No full real object pose or aperture calibration
User reports real setup has no RGB-D. File-derived depth statistics cannot be treated as verified real observations; see Stage 2 round 5 provenance correction.
